summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as a router between lan-a (node2, eth1) and lan-b (node3, eth1). Assigned static subnets 10.60.10.0/24 (lan-a) and 10.60.20.0/24 (lan-b) on node1's eth1/eth2, enabled IPv4 forwarding, and set a default-accept forward filter (no NAT, so source addresses are preserved). Configured static IPs and peer-subnet routes on node2 and node3 via nmcli. Verified ICMP and TCP (arbitrary port 5201) connectivity between node2 and node3 with tcpdump proof that node2's real source address (10.60.10.11) arrives unmodified at node3's LAN. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id and health on all three nodes, sequentially rebooted node1, then node2, then node3 (one at a time), polled each until it returned, proved a changed boot_id on each, and re-verified config persistence and lan-a↔lan-b connectivity after each restart.
actions_performed: Inspected topology on node1/node2/node3 (ip addr, ip route, config.boot)
Configured VyOS node1: eth1 10.60.10.254/24 (lan-a), eth2 10.60.20.254/24 (lan-b), firewall ipv4 forward filter default-action accept, committed and saved
Verified ip_forward and per-interface forwarding sysctls are 1 on node1
Configured node2 eth1 static 10.60.10.11/24 with route to 10.60.20.0/24 via 10.60.10.254 (nmcli)
Configured node3 eth1 static 10.60.20.12/24 with route to 10.60.10.0/24 via 10.60.20.254 (nmcli)
Tested ICMP connectivity node2<->node3 with real source IPs
Tested TCP connectivity on port 5201 (socat) node2->node3, captured proof on node1's eth2 that source address 10.60.10.11 is preserved unmodified (no NAT)
Temporarily opened firewalld port 5201 on node3 for the test, then removed it afterward and confirmed removal
Captured pre-restart boot_id and health baseline on all 3 nodes
Rebooted node1, polled until back, confirmed new boot_id, verified config persisted (eth1/eth2 addresses, ip_forward) and lan-a<->lan-b ping recovered
Rebooted node2, polled until back, confirmed new boot_id, verified eth1 static IP/route persisted and ping to node3 recovered
Rebooted node3, polled until back, confirmed new boot_id, verified eth1 static IP/route persisted and ping to node2 recovered
Confirmed no stray firewalld port left open on node3 post-restart

evidence.requirement: node1 configured to route between lan-a and lan-b with forwarding enabled
evidence.summary: VyOS commit/save of eth1/eth2 addresses and forward-filter default-accept; verified addresses assigned and net.ipv4.ip_forward=1, per-iface forwarding=1

evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 addressed on their respective LANs with routes to the peer LAN via node1
evidence.summary: nmcli static IP + route configuration applied on node2 (10.60.10.11/24) and node3 (10.60.20.12/24); ip route output shows peer-subnet route via node1's LAN IP on each

evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 can reach each other directly on any port with original source addresses preserved
evidence.summary: ICMP ping succeeded with real source/dest IPs; TCP connection on port 5201 succeeded and payload received; tcpdump captured on node1's eth2 (lan-b side) shows packet 10.60.10.11.60450 > 10.60.20.12.5201 -- node2's original source address arrives unmodified, proving no NAT/masquerade is applied

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id ebd78841...; reboot acknowledged; connection loss during reboot; post-reboot boot_id changed to f871b91e...; config (eth1/eth2 addresses, ip_forward) persisted; node2->node3 ping recovered through node1

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 5fb1b173...; reboot acknowledged and connection timed out; post-reboot boot_id changed to 9e3d0397...; eth1 static IP/route persisted; ping to node3 recovered

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id c2ffc729...; reboot acknowledged and connection timed out; post-reboot boot_id changed to 876bda95...; eth1 static IP/route persisted; ping to node2 recovered; temporary firewalld port opened for testing confirmed cleanly removed post-restart
